relations.subject: Sakkottai Krishnaswamy Aiyangar
relations.evidence: graduated in history from the University of Madras in 1897.

relations.subject: Sakkottai Krishnaswamy Aiyangar
relations.evidence: In 1899, he obtained his M. A. from the University of Madras

relations.subject: Sakkottai Krishnaswamy Aiyangar
relations.evidence: taught as a lecturer at the Central College of Bangalore from 1899 to 1909.

relations.subject: Sakkottai Krishnaswamy Aiyangar
relations.role: chair of the department of Indian history and archaeology
relations.evidence: In 1914, the University of Madras appointed Krishnaswamy Aiyangar to the chair of the department of Indian history and archaeology. Aiyangar headed the department till 1929.

relations.subject: Shafaat Ahmed Khan
relations.evidence: Journal of Indian History which was started by Shafaat Ahmed Khan in 1921.

relations.subject: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri
relations.role: chair of the Department of Indian History and Archaeology
relations.evidence: Krishnaswamy Aiyangar was succeeded by K. A. Nilakanta Sastri to the chair of the Department of Indian History and Archaeology in 1929.

relations.subject: Sakkottai Krishnaswamy Aiyangar
relations.evidence: Krishnaswamy Aiyangar assisted Robert Sewell in his analyses of the epigraphy and archaeology of South India.
